course.title: English B1 → B2: Independent User
course.subtitle: 64 guided hours across 8 modules, built around the Learn → Practise → Produce → Review → Get feedback loop.
course.description: A 64-hour guided course that takes a B1 learner to a solid B2. Eight themed modules of eight lessons each cover grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking and writing, with spaced-repetition vocabulary, AI feedback on every recording and draft, and four assessment checkpoints. Designed for 8 hours a week over 8 weeks, or 45 minutes a day over roughly 9 weeks.

daily_flow.label: Input
daily_flow.description: Short grammar explanation, article or audio.

daily_flow.label: Practice
daily_flow.description: Interactive exercises, listening questions or reading tasks.

daily_flow.label: Output
daily_flow.description: Voice recording, writing prompt or chat-based role-play.

daily_flow.label: Feedback
daily_flow.description: Corrections, alternative phrasing and a progress update.

checkpoints.title: B1 consolidation
checkpoints.description: A grammar quiz on the two module grammar areas, a two-minute recording and a short email. Confirms the learner can operate reliably at B1 before the pace lifts.

tasks.title: Grammar quiz
tasks.detail: 24 items: present perfect vs. past simple, narrative tenses, future forms, conditionals.

tasks.title: Two-minute recording
tasks.detail: Describe a major change in your life and one plan for the next year.

tasks.title: Short email
tasks.detail: An informal email of 120–150 words catching up with a friend.

checkpoints.title: Mid-course review
checkpoints.description: A listening task, a reading task and a 180-word review. Checks that comprehension keeps pace with production.

tasks.title: Listening task
tasks.detail: Two short audio extracts with detail and inference questions.

tasks.title: Reading task
tasks.detail: A 400-word article with skimming, scanning and inference questions.

tasks.title: Review
tasks.detail: A 180-word review of an app, film or product.

checkpoints.title: B2 readiness
checkpoints.description: A 200-word essay and a three-minute opinion talk. The first checkpoint scored against B2 criteria.

tasks.title: Argument essay
tasks.detail: 200 words on a health or ethics question.

tasks.title: Three-minute opinion talk
tasks.detail: Present and defend a position, then answer two follow-up questions.

checkpoints.title: Final B2 assessment
checkpoints.description: Timed reading and listening, a 200–220-word essay and a speaking interview. Produces the personalised B2-readiness report.

tasks.title: Timed reading
tasks.detail: Two texts in 25 minutes: meaning, information, opinion, detail.

tasks.title: Timed listening
tasks.detail: Three extracts in 20 minutes with note-taking.

tasks.title: Essay
tasks.detail: 200–220 words arguing a position with examples.

tasks.title: Speaking interview
tasks.detail: Three-minute talk plus follow-up questions on organisation and pronunciation.

badges.title: First 2-Minute Monologue
badges.description: Record a spoken answer of at least two minutes and have it evaluated.

badges.title: Essay Completed
badges.description: Submit an essay or formal piece and receive feedback.

badges.title: 100 Collocations Learned
badges.description: Recall 100 vocabulary items correctly in review.

badges.title: Ten Recordings
badges.description: Submit ten speaking recordings across the course.
